sign: offset = z_model - z_obs (stage m, shore normal); positive = model shoreward of the observed outer whitewater edge

summary.rule: per (scene, spot) on the main scenes, K = 6: an arm is CONTRADICTED when its H1/10 line sits more than 2σ (16 m) shoreward of the median station outer foam edge; among consistent arms the Hs/Ks line nearest the median foam edge is 'closest' when it leads the next by >= 2σ; the q10 envelope is a bound, not scored
